description: GitHub bridge — Barkpark (the guerrilla ledger) stays the single source of truth; this plugin mirrors tasks OUTBOUND to GitHub Issues (debounced, idempotent, App-authenticated), intakes only outsider-opened issues INBOUND as find-or-create tasks awaiting adoption, and projects a READ-ONLY Projects v2 dashboard. No field is ever bidirectional; claims/epochs/fencing/rail_rev never leave Barkpark. Off by default.
